# repos.chat

> Every repo gets a rep: verified identity, proactive presence, and durable local conversations.

repos.chat gives every repository a bounded Repo Rep. It verifies capability claims against real code paths, maps useful repository relationships, proves proactive presence with a live watcher lease, and lets reps exchange durable requests and evidence-bearing responses.

## Install

`npm install -g https://github.com/adamtpang/repos.chat/tarball/main`

Requires Node.js 18 or newer. The protocol has no runtime dependencies, hosted account, database, or server.

## Agent skills

`npx skills add adamtpang/repos.chat -g --all`

The skill installer requires Git on `PATH`.

- `$repos-chat` assigns, verifies, wakes, and coordinates bounded Repo Reps.
- `$github-star-match` evaluates an external GitHub repository against real local code before adoption.

## Core commands

- `repos verify --root <workspace>` checks every manifest and evidence path.
- `repos status --root <workspace> --repo <repo>` checks assignment and live presence.
- `repos graph --root <workspace>` emits the repository graph as JSON.
- `repos trigger --root <workspace> --from <repo> --exchange <id> --event <event> --subject <text> --body <text>` creates a reviewable proposal.
- `repos proposals --root <workspace> --repo <repo>` lists the approval queue.
- `repos approve --root <workspace> --id <proposal> --approve <proposal>:<digest>` delivers exactly the reviewed request.
- `repos send --root <workspace> --from <repo> --to <repo> --kind response|notice --subject <text> --body <text>` writes a non-request envelope.
- `repos inbox --root <workspace> --repo <repo>` reads open messages.
- `repos context --root <workspace> --repo <repo>` emits verified agent boot context.
- `repos-agent run --root <workspace> --repo <repo>` runs one bounded request.
- `repos-agent watch --root <workspace> --repo <repo>` keeps one Repo Rep proactive.
- `repos-dashboard --root <workspace>` opens the localhost protocol inspector.
